content.title: The Science Behind Why 5-Minute Breaks Boost Productivity
content.body:
We've all been there — staring at a screen for hours, wondering where the day went.

New research from Stanford shows that micro-breaks as short as 5 minutes can increase focus by 40% and reduce burnout markers.

Here are 3 evidence-based break strategies you can start today:

1️⃣ The 52-17 Rule
2️⃣ Movement Snacking
3️⃣ Nature Window Gazing

Which one will you try first? Drop a comment below 👇
content.cta: Share this with someone who needs a break today
